Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

bus — a large road vehicle for many people. Example: Take bus 12 to the museum.
train — a vehicle that runs on rails. Example: The train is fast.
stop — a place where a bus picks up people. Example: The bus stop is at the corner.
station — a place where trains stop. Example: The station is near my office.
ticket — a paper that lets you travel. Example: I buy a ticket at the machine.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Take the metro to ...
• The bus stop is at ...
• Buy a ticket at ...
• How do I get to ...?
• It is two stops.

Grammar focus: There is / There are for places in town.
Use by for transport and at for stops: I go by metro. The bus stop is at the corner. Buy a ticket at the station.
